subject.title: fix(deepinfra): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should an operator’s existing `models.providers.deepinfra.request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` opt-in apply to DeepInfra native video-generation HTTP requests, matching headers and proxy policy on that transport?
rationale: The code does not introduce a new setting, but it extends an existing outbound-network permission to a previously hard-coded-deny transport; that policy scope needs maintainer intent rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Confirm uniform request-policy scope
options.body: Treat native video generation as another DeepInfra HTTP transport, preserve the fail-closed default, and merge this focused forwarding fix.

options.title: Keep video fail-closed independently
options.body: Retain the hard-coded video restriction and document why native video must not honor the provider-level request-policy opt-in.

recommendation.title: Confirm uniform request-policy scope
recommendation.body: Treat native video generation as another DeepInfra HTTP transport, preserve the fail-closed default, and merge this focused forwarding fix.
